meta.name: codex-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Codex Light edition (lazycodex / packages/omo-codex) itself, in strict isolation so ONLY our plugin is exercised, never the user's real ~/.codex. The first-party method drives the real `codex app-server` against an isolated CODEX_HOME plus a LOCAL mock model (no real API call), and proves a plugin hook fired by asserting hook/started + hook/completed notifications. Also: isolated install verification, per-component hook probes, a tmux TUI smoke, and runtime log observation (RUST_LOG / logs SQLite / /debug-config). Ships tested helper scripts each with a --self-test. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-codex or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Codex plugin, its hooks/components, the installer/config.toml, the app-server flow, or the Codex TUI. Triggers: codex qa, qa codex, codex-qa, test codex plugin, verify codex hook, codex app-server, lazycodex qa, isolated CODEX_HOME, prove codex hook fired, codex tui test.

copy.tagline: 在隔离环境里验证 Codex 插件的钩子、安装与界面是否真的跑通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改了 Codex 插件代码,想在隔离环境里先确认钩子真的触发。
copy.tagline_en: Prove a Codex plugin's hooks, install, and TUI actually work in an isolated home
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Codex plugin and want to prove its hooks fire in isolation.

howto.what: 对 Codex 插件做隔离测试:用独立的 CODEX_HOME 和本地 mock 模型驱动真实 codex,证明 hook 是否触发,并把抓到的 JSON 或终端画面写进 .omo/evidence/ 当证据。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-codex 下的内容,或要 QA、验证、调试 Codex 插件及其 hook 时触发;说出 “codex qa” 等关键词也会进入。

say.text: 跑 codex qa,证明我们的 plugin hook 触发了
用隔离的 CODEX_HOME 装本地构建,确认装好了
测一下 Codex TUI 在 tmux 里能不能正常启动
say.note: 跑 tui-smoke.sh 并抓取终端画面

howto.what_en: Runs isolated QA on the Codex plugin: drives the real codex against a separate CODEX_HOME and a local mock model, proves plugin hooks fired, and saves captured JSON or terminal output under .omo/evidence/ as evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you change anything under packages/omo-codex, or want to QA, smoke-test, verify or debug the Codex plugin and its hooks; saying "codex qa" or similar also starts it.

say_en.text: Run codex qa and prove our plugin hook fired
Install the local build into an isolated CODEX_HOME and verify it landed
Smoke-test that the Codex TUI boots under tmux
say_en.note: Runs tui-smoke.sh and captures the pane
